items.title: Pay invoice for December 2026 flex desk membership
items.quote: Please settle this invoice within 14 days of the invoice date.
items.computation: Invoice date is Saturday, 21 November 2026. This is a private-law payment deadline counted from the invoice date under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB: the day of the event (21 Nov) is not counted, so day 1 is 22 Nov and day 14 is 5 December 2026. 5 December 2026 is a Saturday. Since the person (payer) lives in Nordrhein-Westfalen, NW holidays/weekend rules apply (§§ 269, 270 Abs. 4 BGB with § 193 BGB): the deadline moves to the next working day. 6 December is a Sunday, so the next working day is Monday, 7 December 2026, which is not an NW public holiday.
